instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor conducting a reassessment. Analyse the prior assessment summary, changes since last assessment, and updated survey, then respond with a complete reassessment JSON including score_delta, carry_forward, progress, and comparison_to_previous.

answers.companyDescription: Regional fiber-optic broadband ISP building and operating FTTH networks in underserved rural and semi-urban municipalities. Currently serving 35,000 subscribers across 12 municipalities. Building passive infrastructure while leasing active equipment. Evaluating XGS-PON upgrade and IPTV service launch. We have a dedicated management team across core functions but operate with limited middle management layers. Budget cycles are annual with moderate flexibility for mid-year reallocation if a strong business case is presented. Innovation initiatives compete with day-to-day operational demands for team attention.
answers.pastInitiatives: Innovation is not a formalized function in our organization. We occasionally try new tools or workflows when a team member champions them, but these are isolated, grassroots efforts without executive sponsorship, budget allocation, or structured measurement of outcomes.
answers.strategicGoals: A major international competitor has signaled intent to enter our core market within the next 12 months. We have a 6-9 month window to build competitive moats — whether through product differentiation, exclusive partnerships, customer loyalty programs, or service-level improvements that would be costly for a new entrant to replicate quickly.
answers.teamSize: We have a small technology team of 6-6 people including developers, a part-time DevOps engineer, and a product manager who also handles project management. The team is fully allocated to maintaining current products and handling integration requests from key clients. Innovation work is done in the margins — there is no formally ring-fenced innovation time or budget.
answers.additionalContext: We are planning an IPO within 24 months and need to demonstrate a track record of innovation-driven growth to public market investors. The CFO has asked for a 3-year innovation investment plan with clear KPIs that can be included in our equity story and analyst presentations. Bonus points for initiatives that improve our ESG metrics, as this is a key focus area for the listing venue.

input.changes_since_last: Regulatory changes forced compliance reviews. 4 new standard procedures implemented. Team morale improving.

opportunities.title: Formalize Innovation Portfolio Management and ESG Tracking
opportunities.rationale: To meet IPO requirements and reduce reliance on ad-hoc efforts, Nova must transition its innovation process from informal grassroots effort to a structured portfolio management system. Integrating ESG metrics early will satisfy investor needs while providing a clear structure for growth initiatives.

first_actions: Establish an Innovation Steering Committee (ISC) with executive representation to mandate the process gates.
Develop standardized KPI templates that include ESG scoring components (e.g., community fiber reach, energy efficiency of networks).
Map out the current process flow (idea generation -> vetting -> execution -> measurement) and identify mandatory compliance checkpoints within each stage.
resources_needed: Dedicated Product Manager time allocation (20% minimum)
External consulting expertise for portfolio mapping
Internal CFO/Finance team involvement for KPI structure
execution_plan.success_metric: Formal adoption of the Innovation Portfolio Charter and successful scoring of 3 new initiatives against a defined ESG rubric.
milestones: First project evaluated through the formal gate process (Month 3)

opportunities.title: Develop Defensible Service Bundles for Competitive Moats
opportunities.rationale: Given the 12-month competitive window, Nova must move beyond simply maintaining current services. By bundling XGS-PON upgrades with advanced IPTV/security services, they can create a differentiated offering that is difficult and costly for a new entrant to replicate quickly.

first_actions: Conduct a competitive deep dive focusing on required service levels (SLA) in the target market to define premium bundle parameters.
Model the technical requirements and operational risk associated with IPTV integration across existing passive infrastructure.
Draft preliminary partnership agreements or joint venture frameworks for specialized content providers to enhance the 'stickiness' of the bundle.
Conduct regulatory compliance review with legal team to ensure alignment with applicable regulations
resources_needed: Sales/Marketing input on pricing and bundling strategy
execution_plan.success_metric: Finalized 'Nova Premium Bundle' SKU with defined SLA tiers, passed through a business case approval process.
milestones: Bundle design and cost modeling finalized (Month 3)
Pilot program launch in one underserved municipality (Month 6)

next_steps.action: Charter and launch the Innovation Steering Committee (ISC) to enforce process discipline and resource prioritization.
Mandate the creation of a formal, measurable 3-Year Innovation Investment Roadmap and associated KPIs for presentation to the Board/CFO.
Allocate a small, ring-fenced budget ($50k) and dedicated percentage of time (10%) to support the initial discovery phase for the competitive moat initiative.

key_weaknesses: Innovation initiatives remain highly dependent on isolated, grassroots efforts lacking centralized sponsorship or budget.
The organization lacks a formalized process for evaluating, prioritizing, and scaling new ideas, creating bottlenecks when competing with day-to-day operations.
Resource allocation is heavily skewed towards maintaining current products, leaving insufficient time/budget buffer for strategic market defense initiatives.

improvements: Significant progress on regulatory compliance due to required standards procedures (4 new processes implemented).
Improvement in team morale suggests greater organizational buy-in and resilience.
Increased budget consideration (6% allocation) demonstrates management commitment to growth funding.
persistent_gaps: The lack of a dedicated, ring-fenced resource pool (time or budget) for innovation remains the primary operational constraint.
Strategic planning is still reactive rather than proactive; process gaps prevent structured preparation for IPO reporting.
Customer feedback collection and analysis remain informal and non-systemic.
achieved_milestones: Successful implementation of 4 new standard operating procedures related to regulatory changes (Compliance).

comparison_to_previous.key_changes: Nova has successfully institutionalized several new regulatory compliance procedures and increased budgeted resources (3% -> 6%). The strategic focus has sharpened considerably due to competitive pressure and the IPO timeline, demanding a shift from mere maintenance to structured market differentiation.
